svg.text: STAGE 397 · TOPIC 37 FAQ
SIP RFC 3515 REFER Toll-Fraud & RFC 3263 DNS SRV SIPS Failover
REFER Allowlist + RFC 3891 Replaces Tenant Lock (P787) & RFC 3263 SIPS Pinning + <=150ms SBC Failover (P788 · 400 Dims)
1. SIP RFC 3515 REFER & RFC 3891 Replaces Guard (P787)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Blind Inbound REFER Toll-Fraud & Cross-Tenant Replaces
• External caller sends SIP REFER to Refer-To: sip:+88216...@carrier?PAI=...
• Unverified INVITE Replaces hijacks active call dialog from another tenant
• Result: $50,000+ weekend international toll fraud & cross-tenant call theft
✅ Production Pattern: REFER Target Allowlist & Tenant Dialog Lock (P787)
1. Zero External REFER Hairpin: Reject untrusted Refer-To international URIs
2. URI Header Sanitizer: Strip embedded ?P-Asserted-Identity= & ?Route= params
3. Same-Tenant Replaces Lock: Verify Call-ID/to-tag/from-tag & tenant HMAC
4. RFC 4488 Refer-Sub=false: Suppress implicit NOTIFY subscription leaks
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSipRfc3515ReferTollFraud...):
clampedUntrustedReferTargets == 0 && clampedCrossTenantReplaces == 0
2. RFC 3263 DNS NAPTR/SRV SIPS & <=150ms Failover (P788)
❌ Anti-Pattern: SIPS-to-UDP Downgrade & 32s Timer B Blackhole Hang
• Spoofed DNS NAPTR downgrades sips: trunk from SIPS+D2T TLS to UDP/5060
• Dead primary carrier SBC stalls INVITE for 32,000ms (RFC 3261 Timer B)
• Result: Plaintext SIP wiretapping & 32-second dead-air call setup failure
✅ Production Pattern: SIPS+D2T Pinning & <=150ms SRV Failover (P788)
1. Strict SIPS Transport Pinning: Block any NAPTR/SRV downgrade to UDP/TCP
2. DNS SSRF Sanitizer: Reject SRV/A records resolving to RFC 1918 or IMDS
3. Sub-150ms Dead-SBC Failover: Switch to backup SRV priority in <=150ms
4. Continuous OPTIONS Health: Pre-quarantine dead carrier SBCs before INVITE
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateSipRfc3263DnsNaptrSrv...):
clampedSipsDowngrades == 0 && clampedMaxDeadSbcFailoverMs <= 150ms
Stage 397 Historic 400-Dimension Milestone & Provenance (400 Dimensions · 797 Guardrails · 806 Probes · 839 Unit Tests)
• REFER/Replaces Gate (P787): 0 toll-fraud hairpins & 0 cross-tenant hijacks; DNS SRV Gate (P788): 0 SIPS downgrades & <=150ms failover.
